name: text-iterative-unplanned
source: The text replay (base) in the iterative mode with the plan of the 2026-10-11 live run that left out the text validator: the initial phase ends with the corpus design, and the first round analyses and drafts without validating. The validation check must pass before the draft (before = ["paper_drafter"]), so the text validator is sent out before the drafter.

work_orders.focus: Run the analysis the corpus design declares.
Draft the paper from the results.

iterations.rationale: The corpus is built; analyse and draft.

ceiling_checks.reason: The draft reports the checked results.
